title: 15th Sitting of Second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/15/2/2026).

Unfinished business: continued debate on the resolution by Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir noting that many people are being politically dismissed from state-owned companies under the name of downsizing, to establish Parliament's view on the matter.
Economic Committee report on the President's nominee for Commissioner General of Taxation (Tax Administration Act, Law No. 3/2010, Article 8(a)).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: A short sitting that continued the SOE dismissals resolution debate and considered the committee report on the Commissioner General of Taxation nominee.
